verdict.rationale: Bevy offers an in-depth reference documentation with inline examples (bevy-docs-27) and a separate examples gallery that runs directly in the browser via WASM with viewable source (bevy-docs-16, bevy-docs-34), which together approximate an interactive, runnable API reference experience. However, these are two separate systems rather than a single interactive reference where you can run examples directly from the API docs, and probes show no llms.txt, no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and community notes describe docs as limited and hard to navigate (bevy-comm-14, bevy-comm-15). Missing for 10: a unified interactive reference (like Rust Playground embedded in docs) combining API browsing with inline runnable code, and independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
